newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Telstra sees foreign investment cash positive.
newsitem.headline: Telstra sees foreign investment cash positive.

text.p: Telstra of Australia said on Monday almost all its foreign investments would be cash positive by the end of its current financial year ending June 30.
Chief executive officer Frank Blount told a news conference the government-owned company had set itself a goal of getting a return on all its foreign stakes by the end of the current fiscal year.
"We've just about met that objective," he said.
"With a couple of exceptions ... I believe they will all be cash positive by the end of this year," he added.
Blount declined to give a forecast of when they would be profitable, but said they were heading in the right direction.
"That means they are on track ... to getting into profitability," he said. "The first thing is to get all these investments onto the positive side of the ledger."
He said that as far as he could recall the two non-cash positive investments were in Khazakhstan and India. He gave no further details.
